title: sos_alert_to_cbor encoder emits coordinates its own decoder rejects
description: sos_alert_set_location void/unvalidated (sos_alert.h:134-137 documents ranges); to_cbor no value validation (sos_alert.c:405-495): local NaN/91.0 serializes onto air where receivers drop. Validate in setter (return int err) mirroring decoder bounds/non-finite checks, or validate encode-time consistently documented.
close_reason: sos_alert_set_location changed void->int returning SOS_ALERT_ERR_INVALID_VALUE when !coordinate_in_range(lat,90) or !coordinate_in_range(lon,180), SOS_ALERT_OK otherwise; atomic on failure (previous location state retained so encoder can never emit coordinates its own decoder rejects); encode path to_cbor left simple per instruction. Header prototype and @return/range contract documented at include/lichen/sos_alert.h. Caller audit: repo-wide grep finds zero call sites outside header+impl, nothing needed migration. clang -std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Werror -fsyntax-only passes.
